narrative.overview: MaskanScan is a high-density, spatial instrument built specifically for rapid exploration and analysis of Tehran's rental market. The interface recedes cleanly into the background, prioritizing the geospatial map canvas while floating glassmorphic panels and drawer controls afford effortless filtering, price conversion, and listing inspection.
keyCharacteristics: Spatial-first canvas with layered translucent glass interfaces (backdrop-blur-md).
High-contrast Persian typography driven by IRANSansX with strict RTL spatial rhythm.
Vibrant saffron-orange brand accent deployed with disciplined rarity for actionable elements.
Information-dense cards with clear visual hierarchy, badge attribution, and instant spatial feedback.

rules.name: The Rarity of Orange Rule
rules.body: The primary saffron-orange accent is reserved strictly for interactive state, selected pins, and confirmed CTA actions. It covers <= 10% of any viewport.

rules.name: The Portal Attribution Rule
rules.body: Scraped listings must retain their distinct portal badges (Divar, Sheypoor, Kilid, MrEstate) to guarantee source authenticity.

rules.name: The Native Persian Digits Rule
rules.body: All numerical figures (prices in Tomans, areas in sq.m, bedroom counts, dates) must render with Persian digits (۰-۹).

rules.name: The Glass-Over-Map Rule
rules.body: Any panel or widget that hovers over the map canvas must feature background opacity (bg-background/95) and backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-md).

dos: Do format all currencies in Persian Tomans using formatToman() with Persian digits.
Do preserve strict RTL alignment across all layout containers, drawer transitions, and text elements.
Do display original source attribution badges with accurate portal colors on listing cards.
Do use backdrop-blur-md on floating navigation and drawer panels.
donts: Don't use standard English digits (0-9) inside Persian text copy or price tags.
Don't flood entire panels with solid orange backgrounds; keep accent usage disciplined (<= 10%).
Don't use heavy dark drop shadows that obscure map details underneath translucent drawers.
Don't mix left-to-right alignment in form fields except for raw phone numbers or English URLs.
